description: Source code for the Kubernetes custom metrics client, implementing methods to interact with metrics API endpoints, including namespace and object-specific metric retrieval, with version conversion and client configuration.

classes.name: customMetricsClient
classes.description: Client for interacting with Kubernetes custom metrics API, supporting versioned and namespace-specific metrics.

classes.name: rootScopedMetrics
classes.description: Handles metrics at the cluster scope.

classes.name: namespacedMetrics
classes.description: Handles metrics within a specific namespace.

methods.name: NewForVersion
methods.description: Creates a new custom metrics client for a specific API version.

methods.name: NewForVersionForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new custom metrics client for a specific API version with configuration.

methods.name: RootScopedMetrics
methods.description: Returns an interface for cluster-scoped metrics.

methods.name: NamespacedMetrics
methods.description: Returns an interface for namespace-scoped metrics.

methods.name: qualResourceForKind
methods.description: Returns the resource string for a given GroupKind.

methods.name: getForNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves a specific metric value for a namespace.

methods.name: GetForObject
methods.description: Retrieves a specific metric value for a named object.

methods.name: GetForObjects
methods.description: Retrieves metrics for multiple objects matching a selector.
